info.name: Nile Clinic API
info.description:
Backend API of the Nile Clinic Management System (Laravel 13, `/api/v1`).

Contracts: `specs/001-project-foundation/contracts/health.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/002-staff-auth-roles/contracts/staff-auth.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/003-patient-records/contracts/patients.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/004-doctors-specialties/contracts/doctors.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/005-scheduling-availability/contracts/scheduling.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/006-appointments/contracts/appointments.openapi.yaml`,
`specs/007-patient-queues/contracts/queues.openapi.yaml`, and
`specs/008-medical-encounters/contracts/encounters.openapi.yaml`.

**Run order**: System → Auth/sign in (stores `token`) → Auth → Staff → Patients → Specialties →
Doctors → Scheduling → Appointments → Queues → Encounters → clear weekly schedule → sign out. Select the **Nile Clinic Local** environment and set
`admin_email` / `admin_password` to an administrator created with `php artisan
staff:create-admin`. All data must be synthetic.

Every request sends `Accept: application/json` and `Accept-Language: {{locale}}` (`en` or `ar`);
field names and structure are identical in both locales, only `message` texts change.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sign in, the signed-in member's own account, and sign out (feature 002, US1 and US5).
Tokens expire after 8 hours without a request. After 5 failed attempts for one email, or 20
from one address, within a minute, sign-in is refused for up to a minute.

request.description:

which every other request sends as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Unknown email, wrong
password, and deactivated account all get the same 422 message. Emails are printable ASCII;
case and surrounding spaces are ignored.

item.name: Patients
item.description:
Patient registration and records (feature 003): administrators and receptionists only; doctors
get 403 on every request. The patient number is the record's `id`. Lists never include the
national ID, address, or emergency contact. Contract:
`specs/003-patient-records/contracts/patients.openapi.yaml`.

request.description:
Register a patient. Required: full_name, date_of_birth (not in the future, at most 130 years
ago), sex (male/female), phone (8–15 digits, optional leading +; spaces and dashes removed).
Optional: national_id (14 digits, first digit 2 or 3, unique), address, emergency_contact
{name, relationship, phone}. The new id is stored in `patient_id`. Synthetic data only.

item.name: Scheduling
item.description:
Weekly schedules, time off, and bookable slots (feature 005). Every active staff member can
read them; only administrators change them; `/doctors/me/…` is for doctors. All dates and
times are the clinic's wall clock (`CLINIC_TIMEZONE`, default Africa/Cairo). Runs after
Doctors (uses `doctor_id`); the schedule is kept for Appointments and cleared by
"clear weekly schedule" at the end of the run. Contract:
`specs/005-scheduling-availability/contracts/scheduling.openapi.yaml`.

variable.description: The doctor id (not the staff account id)

request.description:
Replace the whole weekly schedule. appointment_minutes: 5–240, multiple of 5. Per day at
most 4 periods, not overlapping or touching, each at least one appointment long; times
`HH:MM` on 5-minute steps (end may be `24:00`). Gaps between periods are breaks. Every day
here so the slots request below finds slots whatever day the run is on.

response.name: 422 Overlapping periods
response.body: {"message":"On Sunday, periods must not overlap or touch.","errors":{"periods.1":["On Sunday, periods must not overlap or touch."]}}

response.name: 403 Not an administrator
response.body: {"message":"You are not allowed to perform this action."}

All seven days, sunday … saturday; a day without periods is a day off. A doctor without a
schedule gets appointment_minutes null and seven empty days.

item.name: Appointments
item.description:
Booking and managing appointments (feature 006). `/appointments…` is for administrators and
receptionists; `/doctors/me/appointments…` is for doctors. A booking must start on a slot the
doctor currently offers (Scheduling/list slots) and takes that slot's end; booked slots are no
longer offered. A taken time is `409` with a fixed `reason`: `slot_booked` (the doctor) or
`patient_busy` (the patient). Reschedule and cancel only before the start; no-show only from
the start. Runs after Scheduling (uses `patient_id`, `doctor_id`, `slots_from`, `slots_to`).
Appointments are never deleted. Contract:
`specs/006-appointments/contracts/appointments.openapi.yaml`.

exec: pm.expect(data).to.include({ date: pm.collectionVariables.get('slots_from'), start: '09:00', end: '09:20', status: 'scheduled', outside_availability: false });

request.description:
Book the patient into a free slot. date `Y-m-d` from the clinic's today to 90 days ahead;
start `HH:MM` must be a slot start the doctor offers that day (else 422 on `start`). note:
optional, at most 500 characters, administrative only (no medical details). An unknown
patient_id or doctor_id is 422. The id is stored in `appointment_id`.

response.name: 422 Not an available slot
response.body: {"message":"This time is not an available slot for this doctor.","errors":{"start":["This time is not an available slot for this doctor."]}}

response.name: 422 Unknown patient
response.body: {"message":"No patient was found with this patient number.","errors":{"patient_id":["No patient was found with this patient number."]}}

request.description:
The same slot again: 409 with `reason` `slot_booked`. If the doctor is free but the patient
already has an overlapping appointment with any doctor, the reason is `patient_busy`. Clients
branch on `reason`, which is never translated. Of simultaneous bookings for one slot, exactly
one succeeds.

response.name: 409 Patient busy
response.body: {"message":"This patient already has an appointment at this time.","reason":"patient_busy"}

item.name: Queues
item.description:
Check-in on arrival and each doctor's waiting list for the clinic's today (feature 007).
`/appointments/{id}/check-in`, `/queue…`, and `/doctors/{doctor}/queue` are for administrators and
receptionists; `/doctors/me/queue…` is for doctors. Queue numbers start at 1 per doctor and day and
are never reused. Walk-ins never take a slot.

This folder replaces the doctor's weekly schedule with today's whole day ("clear weekly schedule"
removes it later) and needs two slots left today, so run it before 23:20 clinic time. Runs after
Appointments (uses `patient_id`, `doctor_id`, `new_doctor_email`) and leaves nobody waiting. The
requests made as the doctor send `doctor_token`. Contract:
`specs/007-patient-queues/contracts/queues.openapi.yaml`.

variable.description: The doctor id (not the staff account id)

request.description:
Setup: replaces the doctor's weekly schedule with today's whole day, because queues are only for
the clinic's today and this makes slots available at any hour. "clear weekly schedule" removes it
after this folder. Sets `queue_date` and `queue_weekday` in clinic time.

request.description:
Call the first waiting patient in queue order who is not with another doctor right now. Doctors send no
entry id. The patient becomes `with_doctor` with the time.
A doctor has at most one patient at a time: 422 `visit_in_progress` on `queue`.

response.name: 422 Visit in progress

request.description:
Finish the visit of the patient with the doctor: the entry becomes `seen` with the time, and its
appointment, if any, becomes `completed`. Nobody with the doctor is 422 `no_current_visit`.

response.name: 422 No current visit
response.body: {"message":"No patient is with the doctor.","errors":{"queue":["No patient is with the doctor."]}}

request.description: The next waiting patient in queue order.
Finishes the second visit, so everyone on the list has now been seen.
Nobody can be called: 422 `nobody_waiting` on `queue`, and nothing changes.
After the visit, the appointment is `completed`. Like `checked_in`, it keeps its slot and cannot be rescheduled, cancelled, or marked no-show.
Setup: the same patient can join again once seen. The new entry is stored in `queue_left_entry_id`.
A waiting patient left: the entry becomes `left` with the time, stays on the list, and is never called. Administrators and receptionists.
Only a waiting entry can be marked as left or undone: 422 `not_changeable` on `entry`.

response.body: {"message":"This queue entry can no longer be changed.","errors":{"entry":["This queue entry can no longer be changed."]}}

is `scheduled` again. Its queue number is not reused. A walk-in is corrected by marking it as left.

item.description:
Medical records of visits (feature 008). Doctors only: administrators and receptionists get 403.
One record per visit, for booked patients and walk-ins alike. A draft is visible only to its
author; a finalized record cannot be changed, only corrected with addenda. Clinical content is
returned only when one record is opened, never in a list. Anything a doctor may not read is the
same 404 as something that does not exist.

This folder signs in as the doctor from "Doctors/create doctor account" and sends `doctor_token`
by default; the requests that act as the administrator set their own auth. Runs after Queues
(uses `patient_id`, `doctor_id`, `new_doctor_email`). Records are never deleted. Use synthetic text
only. Contract: `specs/008-medical-encounters/contracts/encounters.openapi.yaml`.

request.description:
Setup, as the administrator: a record starts from a visit, so this puts `patient_id` on
`doctor_id`'s list for today. The entry id is stored in `visit_id`. The Queues folder leaves nobody
waiting, so the next call picks this patient.

Setup: signs in the doctor made by "Doctors/create doctor account" and stores the token in
`doctor_token`, which this folder sends by default. The administrator's `token` is kept.

request.description:
Replace all of a draft's content; the author only. Every key must be sent, with null or an empty
array for what is still empty, so a forgotten field gets 422 rather than erasing content. Text fields
up to 10,000 characters; up to 20 prescription lines, each needing a `medication`, with fields up to
500 characters. Clinical text is stored as written, in any language. Synthetic text only.

request.description:
Open one record, the only place clinical content is returned. A doctor reads their own at any
time, and another doctor's finalized records only while the patient is on their list today as waiting,
with them, or seen. Anything else is the same 404 as an unknown id.

Finalizing needs a chief complaint and a diagnosis, and each line's dosage, frequency, and
duration: 422 `required_to_finalize` naming each missing field. The record stays a draft.

request.description:
Correct a finalized record; the author only. `text` is required, up to 10,000 characters. The
original content stays unchanged, and an addendum cannot be changed or deleted. A draft is 422
`not_finalized`; another doctor who may read the record gets 403.

response.name: 422 Not finalized
response.body: {"message":"Only a finalized medical record can have addenda.","errors":{"encounter":["Only a finalized medical record can have addenda."]}}
